# Albertson & Davidson LLP

> California trust and estate litigation law firm specializing in inheritance disputes, trustee accountability, and probate matters throughout the Bay Area and San Diego.

Albertson & Davidson LLP provides legal guidance on trust contests, will disputes, beneficiary rights, and estate administration under California Probate Code. The firm's attorneys, including partners Keith Davidson and Stewart Albertson, handle complex inheritance theft cases, trustee misconduct, disinheritance challenges, and probate litigation.

## Key Topics

- California Probate Code
- Trust litigation and contests
- Beneficiary rights and protections
- Trustee duties and accountability
- Inheritance disputes and theft
- Undue influence and elder abuse
- Disinheritance challenges
- Estate administration
- Will contests and probate litigation
- Trust accounting requirements
- Probate Code sections 16061.5, 17200, 850, 21135
- Community property and marital rights
- Trial preparation and expert witnesses
- Mediation in trust disputes

## Beneficiary Rights and Trust Access

- [How to Obtain a Copy of a Deceased Loved One's Will or Trust](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/wheres-the-will-how-can-i-see-the-will-of-a-deceased-loved-one): Guide to obtaining will/trust copies in CA per Probate Code 16061.5
- [Dealing With Bad Trustees: How Can I Make them Give me Information?](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/how-can-i-make-the-trustee-give-me-information): Beneficiary rights to compel trustee disclosure and information access
- [What Type of Trust Accounting Do You Need? | Albertson & Davidson](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/what-type-of-trust-accounting): Explains formal vs. informal trust accounting and beneficiary rights
- [What to Do if you Have Problems with your Inheritance?](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/how-do-you-take-action-in-your-bay-area-trust-or-will-contest): Bay Area guide to inheritance disputes per Probate Code 17200 and 850
- [Beneficiaries Do Not Pay Trust Expenses | Albertson & Davidson](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/beneficiaries-do-not-pay-trust-expenses): Trustee duty to pay trust expenses from trust assets, not beneficiaries

## Inheritance Disputes and Theft

- [Inheritance Theft in California: When Trust Is Betrayed](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/inheritance-theft-stories-when-trust-is-betrayed): Keith Davidson on undue influence and inheritance theft in California
- [Three Ways You Could Lose Your Inheritance](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/three-ways-you-could-lose-your-inheritance): Disinheritance, hostile trustees, and reduced shares explained
- [Siblings Argue Lifetime Gifts Be Offset From a Beneficiary's Inheritance](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/stealing-my-gift-my-deceased-parents-gave-me-something-before-they-passed-that-my-siblings-now-say-is-part-of-the-estate): Lifetime gifts and satisfaction doctrine per CA Probate Code 21135
- [The Problem Child's Problem: Estranged Child Contesting a Trust in CA?](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/the-problem-childs-problem-can-an-estranged-child-contest-a-trust): CA law on estranged children contesting trusts and disinheritance
- [Conditions on Inheritance and Locked Share Disinheritance | Disinheritance Three Ways Part Three](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/disinheritance-three-ways-part-three-conditions-inheritance-locked-share-disinheritance): Stewart Albertson on HEMS standards and conditional inheritance trusts

## Trust Administration and Trustee Duties

- [Proper Distribution of Trust Assets to Beneficiaries | Albertson & Davidson](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/how-to-distribute-trust-assets-to-beneficiaries): Trustee duties for proper asset distribution including in-kind transfers
- [Are trust assets frozen automatically when you file a trust lawsuit?](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/are-trust-assets-frozen-automatically-when-you-file-a-trust-lawsuit): Keith Davidson explains TRO/injunction requirements for freezing trust assets
- [When Your San Diego Trust is Troubled | Albertson & Davidson, LLP](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/troubled-trust-administrations-when-your-san-diego-trust-is-troubled): Trustee communication and troubled trust administration in San Diego

## Probate and Estate Administration

- [What Happens If You Don't File Probate in California?](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/what-happens-if-you-dont-file-probate-in-california): Keith Davidson on CA probate requirements and avoidance strategies
- [Power of Attorney vs. Executor: What Are Their Differences?](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/the-differences-between-a-power-of-attorney-and-an-executor): Keith Davidson explains POA vs. executor roles in CA estate administration
- [Are Trusts Considered Marital property in California?](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/marital-rights-trust-assets-california): CA community property law and spousal rights to trust assets

## Litigation and Trial Preparation

- [Exhibit and Witness Lists for your Trial Preparation](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/exhibits-witnesses): Trial prep guide for exhibit and witness lists in CA trust/will cases
- [Experts: What type are there? - Albertson & Davidson, LLP](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/experts-what-type-are-there): Partner Stewart Albertson discusses expert witness types in CA litigation
- [Why Mediation Is Always An Useful Exercise](https://www.aldavlaw.com/blog/useful-exercise-why-mediation-is-always-useful): Benefits of mediation in civil litigation and trust disputes
